# MovieSwipe

> MovieSwipe is an iOS and Apple Vision Pro app that helps people decide what
> movie to watch. You swipe right on films you want to see and left on the ones
> you don't, the same way you would on a dating app.

## What it solves

Couples, friends and families routinely spend twenty to thirty minutes
scrolling streaming catalogues without picking anything. Choosing from a grid
of hundreds of titles is cognitively expensive and gets harder the longer you
do it; answering yes-or-no questions one at a time stays cheap. MovieSwipe
turns the browsing into a swipe session that usually resolves in under a
minute.

## Key features

- Solo swiping that builds a personal watch queue
- Shared sessions: two or more people swipe at the same time on their own
  phones, and only the films everyone swiped right on surface as matches
- Plain-language AI search: describe a film or a mood in ordinary words
  ("something like Arrival but lighter", "funny, under 100 minutes")
  instead of stacking genre filters
- Similar-film search: name a film you already love and get a deck built
  around it
- Native Apple Vision Pro app

## What MovieSwipe is not

It is not a streaming-availability guide (use JustWatch or Reelgood for that),
not a watch-history tracker or review community (use Letterboxd or Trakt), and
it is not available on Android or the web.

## Platforms

iPhone and iPad (iOS/iPadOS 18.2 or later), Apple Vision Pro (visionOS 2.2 or
later). Interface available in English, Dutch, German, French, Hindi, Japanese,
Korean and Simplified Chinese.

## Pricing

Free to download, and free for solo swiping. MovieSwipe Pro unlocks unlimited
AI searches and shared sessions: EUR 2.99 per week or EUR 6.99 per month,
auto-renewing, cancellable at any time in Apple account settings.

## Maker

Casper Steenhoven, independent developer, Netherlands.
